prompt:
Single full-bleed vertical3:5 game upgrade-card painting, final720x1200 RGB. References are this project's original card paintings: match their coarse thick digital oil/impasto brushwork, desaturated dark charcoal/deep brown palette, northern knotwork materials, upper-left key light and heroic slightly low-angle half-length portrait. NOT pixel art, NOT photography, no glossy3D. Face and ALL identifying objects in upper55%; top of head near y8-12%, face around y18-30%, hands above y48%; bottom40% very dark plain drapery/haze with minimal detail, reserved for text overlay. Keep important objects inside x7%-93% and y5%-53%, not cropped. Real anatomically connected hands, coherent weapons and natural face. No text, typography, readable words, border, signature, logo, watermark. Small abstract magical geometric marks allowed, never lines of readable writing. One finished image.
NEW SUBJECT style-only references. Tall formidable sea giantess as a dignified half-length woman, pale as drowned marble, severe cold expression, long soaking wet near-black dark green hair hangs like seaweed in thick strands, no crown, no horns. Opaque fully covering sea-dark linen dress, dark leather shoulder straps with small shell fasteners, no feather/fur cloak. Both anatomically natural hands grip the two sides of ONE slack fishing net held across upper chest: fists at x25% and75%, y40%, mesh panel spans x20-80%, y33-51%. Clear diamond rope mesh strands with knots, a few small shells, tiny old gold fragments, one tarnished ring and a broken sailors' amulet caught in net, not body parts. Sea blue #59B3F2 accent reflected in wet strands and water. Deep sea and faint drowned wooden ship silhouette behind her upper half, subdued not busy. Gentle sea mist at bottom40% fades to near-black, minimal detail. Human-like upper body; no fish tail, no mermaid, no nudity, no cleavage, no sensual pose, no trident. Face, both grips, shell-studded net remain above55% text line.
